_about: Curated benchmark rows behind sCoRE's capability registry. A person (or a reviewed agent run) enters every result with its source; nothing is scraped. Run `bash spells/ingest-capabilities.sh` (add --check to preview). Categories: general, coding, tools, recall. Mark picks the benchmarks and the scale; until a model has rows its numbers stay the estimates in RaBbLE-sCoRE/orchestra/capabilities.json. Row shape: {"model": key, "benchmark": id, "score": raw, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "source": url-or-citation}. Prefer vendor system cards or the benchmark's own leaderboard; third-party reseller tables disagree with each other.
